essence: The capital at full day: statues of dead heroes, canal water, cathedral bells, and a fiddle in an Old Town tavern.
name: Stormwind

essence: A kingdom under the mountain, always mid-shift: forge rings, deep halls, and snow falling outside the gates.
name: Ironforge

essence: Lordaeron's ruined capital, kept by its own dead: crypts, green canals, and an army going about its business below ground.
name: Undercity

essence: The Horde's engine room: war drums at the gates, witch doctors in the Valley of Spirits, and one swell of honor at the hold.
name: Orgrimmar

essence: Dawn flutes over the mesas: rope bridges, a single drum circle on Hunter Rise, and the ancestors remembered at dusk.
name: Thunder Bluff

essence: Night on the world tree: moonwells, temple gardens, and the game's own cues for the city, played where they were written for.
name: Darnassus

essence: Patchwork farms at last light, and a war moving in: Southshore's lighthouse, the river mill, snow on the Alterac peaks.
name: Hillsbrad Foothills

essence: Black pines and lake fog: a village that turns at nightfall, a keep where the worgen came from, and a kingdom behind a wall.
name: Silverpine Forest

essence: A jungle that gives way to the sea: tigers and troll voodoo in the green, wrecks and buccaneers on the coast, and a pirate port waiting at the bottom of the world.
name: Stranglethorn Vale

essence: A stagnant swamp east of Deadwind Pass: a Horde foothold, a black lake, and a sunken troll temple underneath it.
name: Swamp of Sorrows

essence: A river valley walked from the goblin port to the hills: farmland and sunlit glades, then a harvest cult and a stronghold at the valley's head.
name: Riverglades

essence: A wounded land walked end to end: kodo bones and centaur wars, the sea at its edge, and one green corner holding out.
name: Desolace

essence: A canyon of sandstone needles and rope lifts, opening onto a white salt flat where gnomes and goblins race rocket cars in the middle of nowhere.
name: Thousand Needles

essence: The Horde's great crossroads: a golden savanna of kodo herds and long roads, one busy junction, and a dream gone wrong under the middle of it.
name: The Barrens

essence: Rain-soaked marsh on the Kalimdor coast: ogres, black dragon whelps, and Theramore holding the far end.
name: Dustwallow Marsh

essence: Dungeon metal played straight: thrash for the pull, thunder for the boss, and no jokes.
name: Combat

essence: The slow hunt, locked to 80 beats per minute: downtempo and trip-hop timed to the global cooldown.
name: The Stalk

essence: The kill at 160 beats per minute: nineties ragga jungle, one bar per global cooldown.
name: The Kill
